verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Unleash serves an llms.txt at docs.getunleash.io with an "Instructions for AI Agents" section. That section tells agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown, and the evidence pack's many `.md` doc URLs show this works across the docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and documentation of what llms.txt covers beyond the excerpt (e.g. an llms-full.txt or a complete page index).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.getunleash.io/llms.txt # Unleash Documentation
For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
